eyebrow: Docker & Deployment for AI Applications · Chapter Two
subtitle: Lesson 7 · Containerizing AI Applications

eyebrow: The same seven instructions, for real
code:
FROM python:3.12-slim
WORKDIR /app
COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt
COPY app/ ./app/
EXPOSE 8000
CMD ["uvicorn", "app.main:app", "--host", "0.0.0.0", "--port", "8000"]
caption: torch or transformers makes this pip install minutes, not seconds.
A .dockerignore file — skip it and checkpoints upload on every build.
Loaded once at startup, and bound to 0.0.0.0 — not localhost.

eyebrow: Build and run — the exact Lesson 4 loop
code:
docker build -t ai-inference:1.0 .
docker run -d -p 8000:8000 --name ai-inference ai-inference:1.0
curl -X POST localhost:8000/predict -d '[1.2, 3.4, 5.6]'
caption: Nothing about docker build or docker run changes for an AI app.
